accepted.prompt: Production movement sprites for Widow's Bay, exact identity and finely painted gouache card texture of the attached sailor reference. Transparent alpha. Portrait-format sprite sheet, strict 2x2 evenly spaced grid of FOUR separate complete figures, ample margins, no overlapping figures, no labels/numbers/borders/background/floor/stairs/wall/shadow. All RIGHT-facing near-profile. Grey-bearded sailor, navy flat cap, double-breasted navy pea coat with gold buttons, red neckerchief, grey trousers, black boots, NO KIT BAG. IMPORTANT HUMAN PROPORTIONS: copy the reference's SMALL HEAD and LONG torso and legs. A standing-equivalent body is SIX TIMES the height from cap top to chin. Cap-to-chin is only 1/6 of standing-equivalent figure height. DO NOT make large-headed squat cartoon characters. Copy the reference face exactly. Coat shoulder-to-hem about 2.7 times cap-to-chin height, hip-to-boot length about 2.6 times cap-to-chin height. Every pose has the SAME head, coat, limb lengths, anatomical size and scale, even when bent or squatting; don't enlarge bent poses to fill their cells. Card cut edge is fine and pale, source-quality intricate cloth brushwork. No props. Top left JUMP APEX: balanced near top of jump, knees softly tucked, arms out at chest height, upright torso. Top right FALLING: descending upright, long legs stretching down, knees just slightly soft, one boot ahead, arms spread to balance BELOW shoulder height. Bottom left LANDING: deep squat to cushion landing, long thighs bent and shins folded, hands low in front, torso pitched modestly forward, both boots planted on same invisible horizontal line. Bottom right THROW RELEASE: both boots planted, long-legged right-facing stance, front arm extended to right at shoulder height with palm opening just after releasing stone, rear arm back, torso rotated subtly. Do not draw a stone.

earlier.prompt: Create a production game sprite atlas for Widow's Bay using the two attached images as EXACT sailor identity/style references. Transparent background.
